A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
miR- 27a and mi-27b regulate the clearance of damaged mitochondrion by directly suppressing the translation of PINK-1.
miR- 27a and miRNA-27b regulate the expression of PTEN induced putative kinase 2 (PINK1), which in turn regulates the autophagic degradation of mitochondria in a negative feedback manner.
miR- 27a and mi-27b are the first microRNAs identified to regulate mitophagy by targeting PINK1.
The main takeaway from our work is that
miR- 27a/b negatively regulate PINK1-mediated autophagic clearance by targeting its mRNA.
miR-26 and miR-26b can regulate PINK1-mediated mitochondrial quality control and autophagy.
miR-26b is a negative regulator of PINK1 and mitophagy, and miR-26a/b may be a potential therapeutic target for PD.
